scientific_integrity: Novelty is limited to the conditioned joint spatial and stable-clock limit and exact conditional spatial-moment boundary. The originating source already provides the full propagator, survival exponent and absorption-time transition. Classical stable and meander results are acknowledged; this is not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Fixed 0<alpha<1, positive integer start, unbiased lattice nearest-neighbor dynamics, iid rate samples refreshed at fixed positive time intervals. Distributional scaling asserted at refresh epochs; all-time moment threshold for each t>0. Full conditioned path-space convergence, alpha=1, and non-exponential rate correlations are outside scope.
title: The survivor-selected stable clock and spatial-moment reversal in a fluctuating-rate random walk
